faqs.question: When does school start and end in Gilchrist County?
faqs.answer: Students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and finish Friday, May 28, 2027. The last day has early release and final exams. Teacher preplanning starts earlier, but August 11 is the first student day.

faqs.question: When is open house?
faqs.answer: Open house is listed for Thursday, August 6, 2026. Check your school’s announcements for visiting hours and classroom arrangements.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27, 2026. The calendar names November 23-25 Fall Break and November 26-27 Thanksgiving Holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long is Christmas break, and when do classes resume?
faqs.answer: The named Christmas Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4-6 are separate teacher workdays with no student classes, and students return Thursday, January 7. Including weekends, the planned time off runs December 19-January 6, a 19-day stretch.

faqs.question: Do students attend the January 5 Close the Gap day?
faqs.answer: January 5, 2027 is a teacher workday and student holiday. No regular student classes are scheduled. Students also stay home January 4 and 6 before returning January 7.

faqs.question: When is Fair Break?
faqs.answer: Fair Break is March 15-17, 2027, Monday through Wednesday. Students are scheduled to return Thursday, March 18. Including the preceding weekend, that gives families five consecutive days without regular classes.

faqs.question: When is spring break?
faqs.answer: Spring break is April 12-16, 2027. Students are scheduled to return Monday, April 19. With the weekends on either side, the planned time off runs April 10-18.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a shortened school day with early release. It is not a full student holiday. Confirm your child’s dismissal time with the school.

faqs.question: Which dates have early release?
faqs.answer: The nine listed dates are September 16 and October 14, 2026; December 17-18, 2026; March 3 and March 26, 2027; and May 26-28, 2027. The December dates are midterms, and the May dates are final exams.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not give dismissal times. Check your child’s school for pickup, bus and after-school arrangements, especially during the December midterms and May finals.

faqs.question: When are midterm and final exams?
faqs.answer: Midterm exams are December 17-18, 2026, and final exams are May 26-28, 2027. All five dates have early release. Your school will provide the exams your child takes and the daily schedule.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are student holidays during the school year?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes October 23, 2026; January 4, 5 and 6, 2027; and February 16, 2027. These are the teacher workdays that interrupt or extend the student calendar.

faqs.question: Are students off for Labor Day, Veterans Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. The student holidays are Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day; Wednesday, November 11, 2026 for Veterans Day; and Monday, January 18, 2027 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Is Presidents Day a four-day weekend for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Monday, February 15, 2027 for Presidents Day and Tuesday, February 16 for a teacher workday. With the weekend, the break runs February 13-16; classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, February 17.

faqs.question: When are parent conference nights?
faqs.answer: Schools schedule fall conferences within October 12-15, 2026 and winter conferences within January 25-28, 2027. Ask your school for your appointment. These windows do not mean families attend every night or that regular classes are canceled.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: The four quarters end October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 have early release; October 9 and March 12 are not marked as shortened days.

faqs.question: When are progress reports available?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 11 and November 12, 2026, and February 17 and April 21, 2027. Follow your school’s instructions for checking your child’s report.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 16, 2026, January 8, March 19 and June 1, 2027. The June report is after the May 28 last day; it does not add a class day.

faqs.question: When are Bell and Trenton high school graduations?
faqs.answer: Bell High School graduation is Thursday, May 20, 2027. Trenton High School graduation is Friday, May 21. Contact the school for ceremony times, rehearsal and guest details. The calendar does not give a separate senior last day.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates work out to 177 planned attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays from August 11 through May 28, less 32 no-school weekdays. This is a date-based calculation, not an annual total printed by the district. Early-release days count as attendance days.

faqs.question: When are progress reports scheduled?
faqs.answer: The listed progress-report dates are September 11 and November 12, 2027, then February 16 and April 19, 2028. September 11 falls on a Saturday; confirm when the report will be available with your school. That reporting date does not schedule Saturday classes.

faqs.question: When will report cards be issued?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 14, 2027, January 14, March 17 and June 1, 2028. The final report-card date comes after the May 26 end of regular classes.

faqs.question: When are Trenton and Bell graduation ceremonies?
faqs.answer: Trenton High School graduation is Thursday, May 18, 2028. Bell High School graduation is Friday, May 19. The schools will provide ceremony times, rehearsal and guest details. The district calendar does not specify a separate senior last class day.

faqs.question: How many attendance days does the schedule contain?
faqs.answer: The calendar dates yield 175 planned attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays between August 10 and May 26, less 34 no-school weekdays. That is a calculation from the schedule, not an annual total printed in the PDF. Shortened school days still count as attendance days.

faqs.question: Where is the official PDF, and how can I check for changes?
faqs.answer: Download the 2027-2028 School Calendar from the district’s School Calendars page. Follow district and school announcements for any later changes, including weather-related schedules. The annual PDF does not designate reserved weather make-up dates or an open-house date.
